actionCalls.description: Row-lock safe Opportunity write (GTM-247, Safe Update from GTM-175). Runs after the Deals Won posts, as before: the sibling flow deals_won_slack_deal_verification_channel reads Sales_Notified__c, so the flag is deliberately not set any earlier. This runs on an async path, where a lock is reported at the end of the run and the fault connector is never taken; here the locked Opportunity is retried after a delay instead. The bypass stamp is re-stamped at each write, so a late retry still suppresses the Opportunity close flows. The stamp and forecast category are ignored when checking for newer changes, because other automation sets them too; Sales_Notified__c is checked. No fault path on purpose: SafeRecordUpdate only throws when its kill switch is off, and then the run should fail loudly as it did before.

decisions.description: A hard failure of Update_Opp (anything a retry cannot fix, already logged and emailed by SafeRecordUpdate) stops the run here, as the old plain update did by faulting, so the country audit and competitor post do not go out with Sales_Notified__c still false. A pending lock retry, a success, or no Opportunity carries on. The explicit IsNull check makes the no-Opportunity case (Update_Opp never ran, so errorCount is blank) take the default branch on purpose rather than by null comparison.
